name: io.github.Nakagawa-master/ai-answer-guard
title: AI Answer Guard — Check AI Answers & Actions Before Claiming Success
description: Prevent misleading AI 'done' reports and unsafe next steps. Before an assistant answers or acts, this free local read-only MCP examines caller-supplied citation roots for false independence or refutations, actual tool receipts for failure/pending states, and proposed actions for missing permission or irreversible consequences; it returns precise holds and next checks. Useful in everyday AI work without knowing any theory. It does not intercept hosts, authenticate real permissions, or fact-check unsupplied evidence. Optional Nakagawa Master original-source navigator is included, not required.
